text: **dsh-md-view**（DSH web 客户端插件）：为其他客户端插件提供统一的 Markdown 渲染服务。它在浏览器端注册 mdView 服务，调用 DSH 的 MarkdownText 渲染器，并处理文档中的原始 img 标签和相对链接。主要功能包括将图片标签转成 Markdown 图片、按仓库地址补全相对链接、提供 render 和 component 两种调用方式，并为代码块及行内代码保留原文。适合需要在 DSH 插件界面中展示 README 或其他 Markdown 文档的场景；运行时依赖 DSH 客户端提供的 React 和 MarkdownText。

**dsh-md-view** is a DSH web client Markdown service using MarkdownText. Its render and component APIs convert raw image tags and resolve relative links against a supplied repository, while preserving code spans and fences. Use it to display READMEs and documents in DSH plugins.
我想让 DSH 插件把 Markdown 文档显示成统一样式。
能不能在 DSH 里渲染 README，并让里面的相对链接可以打开？
I need a reusable Markdown renderer for documents shown in DSH client plugins.
**dsh-md-view** 的功能「渲染 Markdown」：mdView.render 和 mdView.component 接收文本及可选样式、仓库链接，调用 DSH MarkdownText 并返回 React 元素。
**dsh-md-view** 的功能「处理相对链接和图片」：渲染前转换原始 img 标签；提供仓库名时补全相对地址，代码围栏与行内代码保持不变。

dsh-md-view README · dsh-md-view：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)
plugin: markdown rendering for client plugins, so every surface that shows
markdown (READMEs, journals, pads) renders it the same way through one
service: the harness's own MarkdownText pipeline (GFM, math, footnotes,
shiki-highlighted code with copy buttons) plus the document-specific
handling chat never needs.

There is no UI of its own to visit. Plugins inject the client service
`mdView`:

dsh-md-view README · What it adds to the primitive：- raw `` tags (badges, screenshots) become real images, - document-relative link and image targets resolve against `https://github.com/{repo}/blob/HEAD/...` and the raw content host (when `links.repo` is given), - fenced code blocks and inline code spans are never transformed.
section: What it adds to the primitive

text:
dsh-md-view README · Contract：- Rendered output is React elements with plain text nodes only; markdown
  can never inject HTML (`<script>` stays visible text, a MarkdownText
  rule).
- `links.repo` is optional; without it relative targets stay as written.
- The wrapper stylesheet is installed once by this plugin; consumers add no
  CSS of their own for markdown.
- No persistence; the host half is a stub.

dsh-md-view README · How to install：Requires a DeepSeek Harness checkout and a profile, here `web`. The plugin
has no dependencies:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/dsh-plugins && cd ~/dsh-plugins
git clone https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-md-view.git
dsh-md-view README · from the harness checkout：pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add ~/dsh-plugins/dsh-md-view

dsh-md-view README · verify the profile still composes：pnpm dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Restart the harness. Plugins that inject the `mdView` service can now
render markdown.

dsh-md-view README · Plugins dependent on this：- [dsh-workspace-history](https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-workspace-history) renders compaction journal bodies with it (optional; degrades to plain text)
- [dsh-wo-github](https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-wo-github) renders repository READMEs with it (optional; degrades to plain text)
